verdict.headline: One thing to watch: fresh wallets hold 27.82% of the supply

checks.label: Liquidity
checks.detail: 100.0% is held by the Pons v2 launch locker, which has no way to withdraw it.

checks.label: Mint / blacklist / pause
checks.detail: No mint, blacklist, pause or trading switch in the code.

checks.label: Buy tax
checks.detail: Measured on 3,848 buys in the main pool. The hook's own cut on sells is not visible here.

checks.label: Selling
checks.detail: 1,533 wallets other than the dev have sold.

signals.label: Early buyers sold 82% of what they bought
signals.plain: The first wallets in sold 82% of what they bought, and 5 in 10 buyers are down on it.
signals.basis: 518 wallets in the opening window, from decoded trades

signals.label: The ten largest wallets hold 22% of the supply
signals.plain: The ten largest wallets hold 22% of the supply. Pools and burned tokens are not counted as holders.
signals.basis: balances replayed from every transfer and checked against the contract

signals.label: The dev wallet locked 100% of its tokens until 18 Nov 2026
signals.plain: The dev wallet locked 100% of its tokens in a token locker. Nobody can move them before 18 Nov 2026; then they return to the dev wallet.
signals.basis: dev named by the token's deployer() getter; decoded trades and transfers

signals.label: Fresh wallets hold 27.82% of the supply
signals.plain: 39 of the 98 largest holders had sent fewer than 50 transactions and hold 27.82% of the supply between them. Spreading one buy across new wallets looks like this, and so does a token bought mostly by people new to the chain: it says the supply sits in wallets with no history, not who is behind them. The 37 of them that bought are up 17.6% on what they spent, 88.1% of it not yet sold.
signals.basis: transaction counts at the pinned block

signals.label: 4.37% was bought in the launch transaction
signals.plain: One wallet bought 4.37% of the supply inside the transaction that created the token, before anyone else could trade.
signals.basis: decoded buys in the token's creation transaction

pnl.basis: decoded pool trades, plus tokens still held valued at the last traded price in the pool's quote asset; trades in other quote assets are counted at the rate the token's own trades implied at the time
